execution.description: No longer read: a local source always runs in a VM.

allowed_hosts.description: DNS names the tool VM may reach, on any port; *.example.com covers every subdomain, not the name itself.

presets.description: Named host sets: nix, javascript, python, rust.

auto_nix.description: Allow automatic project shell activation (devenv, flake.nix, shell.nix, default.nix), locally and in VMs. Does not grant network access. Ignored while command_prefix is set.

isolation.description: Where new sessions run: none (on the host) or vm. Each new session can still choose the other when a VM runtime is available. Existing sessions keep theirs.

workspace.description: What new sessions work in: in-place (the repository's own checkout, no branch), worktree (a git worktree on its own branch), or clone (VM sessions only: a private clone whose only remote is a host relay limited to the session's branch; host sessions get a worktree). Each new session can override it. Existing sessions keep theirs.

base_branch.description: The repository's default branch for new sessions: the alternative the new-session prompt's base toggle (Alt+B) offers to the checked-out branch, and the base of sessions created without one (loom run). Unset: the toggle offers the remote's default branch, else init.defaultBranch, else main, and a session created without a base starts from the checked-out branch (HEAD's commit when detached). Each session keeps the base it was created with. Restart to apply.

worktree_dir.description: Exact worktree directory (absolute, ~/ or relative to the repository). Omitted: $XDG_DATA_HOME/loom/worktrees/<repo>-<hash>, defaulting to ~/.local/share. Existing sessions keep their paths. Restart to apply.

auto_rebase.description: Keep each idle session's branch current with its base: off, rebase (replay the branch) or merge. A conflict or an uncommitted worktree asks the agent to integrate instead.

auto_resume.description: After a daemon restart, revive sessions it cut off mid-turn and ask them to continue. Sessions waiting on a person stay interrupted.

commit_reminder.description: Remind an agent that goes idle with uncommitted changes to commit, once per commit.

titles.description: No longer read; session titles are always generated.

notify.description: No longer read; use a hooks entry (on: waiting) instead of the webhook.

allow.description: Only these provider ids may start sessions; omitted allows every one.

deny.description: Provider ids that may not start sessions.

visible_refs.description: Extra ref prefixes advertised to a clone session, such as refs/tags/. Its base and own branch are always advertised. Ref filtering is not a confidentiality boundary: clone sessions must be trusted to read repository history.

max_push_bytes.description: Largest push a clone session may publish to its branch, in bytes.

runtimes.description: Per-provider session VM runtime overrides: artifact (and smolvm) paths for claude, aisdk and codex.

allowed_hosts.description: Exact DNS names VM sessions may reach over HTTPS (port 443); no URLs, IPs or wildcards.

presets.description: Named host sets: nix, javascript, python, rust.

idle_stop_minutes.description: Stop idle session VMs after this many minutes; preserve their workspace and history. Zero disables idle stopping. Open shells, active tasks and keep-warm sessions are excluded.

launcher.description: No longer read. Session VMs always start through the isolation library; remove this setting.

checkout.description: Replaced by session.defaults.workspace (mode) and session.clone (visible_refs, max_push_bytes).

db.description: No longer read. The database lives in $XDG_STATE_HOME/loom/repos/<repo>/loom.db; remove this setting.

author.description: Overrides name/email for the commit author only.

committer.description: Overrides name/email for the committer only.

git.description: Session commit identity. Omit to use your normal Git identity. name/email set both roles; author/committer override one role. Values may use {model}, {modelSlug} and {profile}.

default_provider.description: Provider id new sessions use when the client names none; omitted, or not a configured provider: claude.

idle_stop_minutes.description: Stop the daemon after this many minutes with no client and no running session.

include_event_log_in_editor.description: Open the event log alongside the input on Alt+E. Defaults to false; enabling this may require :wq! in Vim/Neovim.

compat.description: Terminal compatibility mode, for mosh (e.g. from Termux): full redraws, and mouse reporting without any-motion tracking, so there is no hover underline. Clicks and the wheel still work. LOOM_TUI_COMPAT=1 turns it on too. Defaults to false. Restart the TUI to apply.

default_mode.description: Permission mode of a new Claude session when none is chosen and none has been used yet; afterwards the last one used. Omitted: default (manual).

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts (host or host:port) the Claude worker may reach besides its built-in list: api.anthropic.com, claude.ai, platform.claude.com, registry.npmjs.org, npmjs.com.

worker_allowed_hosts.description: Replaced by network.allowed_hosts, which adds to the built-in hosts; this one replaces them.

prompt_cache_ttl.description: Prompt-cache lifetime: default (the provider's own choice), 5m, 1h, or off (no caching, full input price every turn).
